failure.title: Module reset split the query-policy error constructor identity
failure.note: The retained first-failing native test shows one pass and one failure because an otherwise retryable ApiClientError was not recognized after the module graph reset.
failure.diagnosis: The test reset modules before dynamically loading the query client but constructed errors with a statically imported pre-reset ApiClientError. Production correctly uses instanceof, so the distinct constructor identities made the test fixture non-retryable.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
